entities.summary: Xavier Gabaix is a French economist, currently the Pershing Square Professor of Economics and Finance at Harvard University. He has been listed among the top 8 young economists in the world by The Economist. He holds a B.A. in mathematics from the Ecole Normale Supérieure, as well as a Ph.D. in Economics from Harvard University.
